commandCoverage.definition: A family shares a primary action attribute/value across chapter, tab, record and repeated observations. One tested family is not proof of all instances or parameter choices. Enabled status means enabled in at least one recorded observation; conditional or hidden final-UI aliases remain described separately.

coverageLimit: This is observed control coverage, not every button or every conditional business outcome. The CSV explicitly retains unexercised enabled families. A family tested on one record does not prove every record or parameter instance.
